Select molecule ChEMBL ID (aliased as molecule_chembl_id), molecule preferred name (aliased as molecule_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all molecules associated with document CHEMBL1121833. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then compound_records to docs on doc_id. LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter where docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1121833'. Sort the result by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
